Blueface, whose real name is Johnathan Porter, is a Los Angeles rapper who became widely known for his offbeat, unconventional flow and viral personality.

He broke through nationally in 2018 with “Thotiana,” which became his signature song and received major attention after remixes featuring Cardi B and YG. The song eventually became a major commercial hit and helped establish Blueface as one of the most recognizable rappers from Los Angeles.

Blueface has been associated with the West Coast rap scene and has released projects including Famous Cryp, Dirt Bag, and Find the Beat. His music often incorporates Los Angeles street-rap influences, while his public persona has generated just as much attention as his music.

Beyond music, Blueface has remained a frequent subject of social-media and entertainment coverage because of his relationships, family life, livestream appearances, and controversial online moments. His relationship with Chrisean Rock, with whom he has a son, became particularly prominent in the media.

His career has included both major viral success and legal controversies, making him a highly discussed figure in modern Los Angeles hip-hop.
